semantics.line_span: [start,end) including the line terminator; texts of all lines concatenate to the file bytes; no line after a final newline
semantics.truncation: stops before a line that would exceed output_bytes or the reservation payload; complete=false, truncated=true, coverage.reasons says which; a first line that does not fit is OutputBudgetExceeded (output) or ResourceExhausted (reservation)
semantics.whole_file_digest: write_intent and size <= 8 MiB: SHA-256 of all bytes in the same attempt; otherwise null (with a reason when write_intent was requested); never a range hash
semantics.consistency: checked_live only; managed_generation and bounded_stale are Unsupported until T10/T14
semantics.retry: one retry on size/mtime/identity change or path replacement; then VersionConflict
semantics.binary: returned text with NUL or invalid UTF-8 is Unsupported

exports: zcr_fs_read (src/fs/read.zig): Reader{init, readRange (core.ReadRangeFn), fault}, ReadFault, max_attempts, reason_* strings
zcr_fs_read.metadata: Snapshot, snapshot, sameVersion, fileVersion, openRegular, pathIdentity, OpenError
limitations: a write that keeps size, mtime and identity identical during the read cannot be detected without hashing
lines before the range are scanned from byte 0 on every read; there is no line index yet (T13)
Reader.generation is supplied by the caller; T10 owns real workspace generations
hard-linked files are read like any regular file; provenance through aliases is not checked (docs/09 §5)
Linux and Intel macOS are cross-compiled only
